subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"A four-footed animal."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Quadruped**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Quadruped"** refers to an animal that walks on four legs. (चार पैरों वाला जानवर)
 
 
• **Example:** A horse is a quadruped, as it uses all four legs for movement.
 
 
• The word **"Biped"** refers to an animal or being that walks on two legs. (दो पैरों वाला जानवर)
 
 
• **Example:** Humans are bipeds as they walk on two legs.
 
 
• Hence, the correct one-word substitution for "A four-footed animal" is **"Quadruped"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Quadruped**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Biped** (दो पैरों वाला): An organism that uses two legs for walking.
 
 
• **Example:** Ostriches are bipeds that can run at high speeds.
 
 
 
• **Carnivore** (मांसाहारी): An animal that feeds primarily on meat.
 
 
• **Example:** Lions are carnivores that hunt other animals for food.
 
 
 
• **Herbivore** (शाकाहारी): An animal that eats plants.
 
 
• **Example:** Cows are herbivores that graze on grass and plants.
 
 

3b:T902,

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To accuse someone first**.
